policy: Paired same-seed standard/full occlusion. Target originally clear and then fully hidden; peers remain geometrically clear. Report target probability drop minus peer mean drop and fixed .5 crossing. Descriptive only; no pass threshold, tuning or qualification.
limitations: Reused 15M development groups, not fresh evaluation
Synthetic masks and probabilities are not calibrated visibility
Paired images also undergo image-wide normalization; response cannot isolate pooling as causal mechanism
Existing predictions only; no local-head model trained
